title: GarticPotions
description: Gartic Potions is a mod for ultimate stupidity where their are custom potions and items that are OP.
body:
This is gartic potions a really stupid mod where there are four new potions and 1 new item.
the four potions include: Potion of dizzy, Potion of late, Potion of Nooooooob, and Potion of COOKIE. Not all potions do somthing and the new item does not work right now. There will be updates and this mod has NOT been finished yet.
